evidence_note: Stored FRED values are observed data; the yield-curve slope, real policy rate, CPI/PCE year-over-year change, VIX condition, equity/dollar/oil trend, the US net-liquidity proxy and the Macro Environment Score are calculated metrics with published formulas and parameters. Every reading describes the conventional macro backdrop (monetary-policy stance, risk appetite in traditional markets, USD strength, US liquidity conditions, inflation pressure) — never a crypto price forecast, and nothing here is a recommendation.

score.semantic_note: Higher Macro Environment Score means a more accommodative macro backdrop by conventional measures (a steeper/normal yield curve, a lower real policy rate, calmer equity-market volatility, rising equities, a weaker US dollar, expanding US liquidity, and easing commodity-inflation pressure). It describes current macroeconomic conditions using standard indicators; it is not a crypto price prediction and does not convert macro data into a deterministic crypto forecast.
score.vintage_risk_note: Every component here is sourced from FRED and reflects FRED's CURRENT, most-revised figure for each historical date — not the value as it was first published. This platform does not yet track FRED's own real-time ('ALFRED') vintages (ADR-0054, a documented, accepted limitation; RED_TEAM_REPORT.md finding #2), so a historical reading of this score, and anything built on it (regime classification, historical similarity, a domain-score-based backtest), can reflect a later revision that would not actually have been knowable on that date — most plausibly around initial-vs-final GDP/CPI prints or seasonal re-benchmarking of the Fed's own balance-sheet series.

components.label: US Treasury yield curve slope (10y − 2y)
components.evidence: Calculated metric from direct evidence (FRED DGS10, DGS2)
components.direction_note: Steeper/positive slope -> more accommodative; inverted/negative slope -> more restrictive.

components.label: Approximate real policy rate (effective fed funds − CPI YoY)
components.definition: Effective federal funds rate minus trailing 12-month CPI inflation.
components.evidence: Calculated metric derived from direct evidence (FRED DFF, CPIAUCSL)
components.direction_note: Higher real rate -> more restrictive (negative contribution); lower/negative real rate -> more accommodative.

components.label: CBOE Volatility Index (VIX), vs. its long-run reference level
components.definition: VIX close minus a reference level of 20 (a commonly cited long-run average).
components.evidence: Calculated metric from direct evidence (FRED VIXCLS)
components.direction_note: Higher VIX -> more risk-off (negative contribution); lower VIX -> more risk-on.

components.label: S&P 500, 90-day change
components.definition: S&P 500 close now ÷ S&P 500 close 90 days earlier − 1.
components.evidence: Calculated metric from direct evidence (FRED SP500)
components.direction_note: Rising equities -> more risk-on; falling equities -> more risk-off.

components.label: Broad US Dollar Index proxy, 90-day change
components.definition: DTWEXBGS now ÷ DTWEXBGS 90 days earlier − 1 (DXY SUBSTITUTE — see cfi.macro.universe).
components.evidence: Calculated metric from direct evidence (FRED DTWEXBGS)
components.direction_note: A strengthening dollar -> tighter global conditions (negative contribution); a weakening dollar -> looser conditions.

components.label: US net-liquidity proxy, 90-day change (Fed balance sheet − TGA − reverse repo)
components.definition: (Fed balance sheet − Treasury General Account − overnight reverse repo) now ÷ the same composite 90 days earlier − 1. US-only proxy, not a true global aggregate — see cfi.macro.universe.
components.evidence: Calculated metric derived from direct evidence (FRED WALCL, WTREGEN, RRPONTSYD)
components.direction_note: Expanding net liquidity -> more accommodative; contracting -> more restrictive.
components.reason: base net-liquidity level is not positive

components.label: WTI crude oil, 90-day change
components.definition: WTI spot price now ÷ WTI spot price 90 days earlier − 1.
components.evidence: Calculated metric from direct evidence (FRED DCOILWTICO)
components.direction_note: Rising oil -> inflationary pressure, more restrictive-leaning (negative contribution); falling oil -> disinflationary, more accommodative-leaning.

yield_curve.condition_reason: 10y - 2y at or above the steep/normal threshold

real_policy_rate.calculation: effective federal funds rate − trailing 12-month CPI inflation (an approximation; not the Fed's own preferred real-rate measure)

cpi_year_over_year.condition_reason: rose the ±3.00% threshold over the window
cpi_year_over_year.calculation: (value now ÷ value ~90 days earlier − 1); CPI year-over-year uses ~365 days

vix.condition_reason: VIX at or above the elevated (risk-off) threshold

equity_trend.condition_reason: rose the ±3.00% threshold over the window
equity_trend.calculation: (value now ÷ value ~90 days earlier − 1); CPI year-over-year uses ~365 days

dollar_trend.condition_reason: changed less than the ±3.00% threshold over the window
dollar_trend.calculation: (value now ÷ value ~90 days earlier − 1); CPI year-over-year uses ~365 days

oil_trend.condition_reason: rose the ±3.00% threshold over the window
oil_trend.calculation: (value now ÷ value ~90 days earlier − 1); CPI year-over-year uses ~365 days

us_net_liquidity.calculation: Fed balance sheet − Treasury General Account − overnight reverse repo, USD billions (US-only proxy, not a true global aggregate)

us_net_liquidity_trend.reason: base net-liquidity level is not positive
us_net_liquidity_trend.calculation: (value now ÷ value ~90 days earlier − 1); CPI year-over-year uses ~365 days

data_quality.note: Points loaded for the last 430 days. 'backfilled' = history as the provider shows it today (FRED's current, most-revised vintage — may include later corrections); flagged = suspect or conflicting.

not_tracked.reason: FRED's only free daily gold series (LBMA fixing, GOLDAMGBD228NLBM / GOLDPMGBD228NLBM) was discontinued in January 2022 at the rights holder's (ICE Benchmark Administration) request. No other verified, officially documented, $0/keyless gold-price source was found; every free alternative located is an unofficial third-party aggregator whose provenance and terms are unverified. A business decision for the user.

not_tracked.item: True global liquidity aggregate (Fed + ECB + BOJ + PBOC)
not_tracked.reason: Only US components are tracked (Fed balance sheet, TGA, reverse repo, M2). A genuine multi-central-bank aggregate would need additional sources (ECB/BOJ/PBOC balance sheets) not yet verified here — a scope decision, not a silent gap.
